posts.t:
The Stanchies: Boo birds rain on Hughes in return to Vancouver; Canucks lose 4-2 to Wild

canucksarmy.com/news/stanchi...

Gophers m/w hockey sweep.

Gophers beat Iowa for Floyd.

Wild sweep a back-to-back.

Vikings still undefeated.

Wolves still undefeated. 

No Sunday scariest there.
First Wild win for Calvin Pickard in net, who was solid especially at the start and finish of the game.

Wild 4, Vancouver 2.

Hughes goal, assist for 501 career points
Kaprizov 13th goal
Brink scores his first of the year
Shabanov PPG, assist

Wild are 2-1-1 on the trip. At Utah to wrap it up.

Another game, another slick move for a Kaprizov goal. His 13th of the season. Hughes with the assist.

4-0 Wild.
Shabanov with an assist for his first multi-point game with the Wild.

Quinn Hughes does indeed get point No. 500 in Vancouver against his former team. With a power-play goal. 

3-0 Wild.

Bobby Brink with a beauty of a move for his first of the season. 

2-0 Wild.
Shabanov with a PPG for a 1-0 Wild lead late in the first.
Wild broadcast sticking with the feed (not going to commercials) at the first media timeout to show the in-arena video tribute to Quinn Hughes.

Quinn Hughes takes a check along the boards drawing cheers. He's also booed when he touches the puck. 

Vancouver buzzing all over the Wild zone to start.

Wild defeat the Kraken 5-1. 

Kaprizov scores early
Maatta with his first in a Wild sweater
Coleman x2
JEEK
Kraken’s Jared McCann to miss game against Wild with injury

Wild have allowed six goals in two games. 

All six* on the PK.

*technically five, but a power play had just expired on a goal in Edmonton.

Aggressive push from the Wild the last two minutes with the extra attacker but couldn't find the equalizer. 

Wild 0-1-1 so far on the trip.

Wild drop a 2-1 decision to Calgary. 

Special teams again: Wild 0/4 PP, Flames 2/4 PP. 

McCarron with the Wild goal.

Cooley was cool in net for the Flames.
Sturm with an assist for his point of the season, too.
McCarron finally breaks through. His first of the season, Wild on the board in Calgary.
Yurov on the top PP unit with Shabanov out tonight.
Wild have taken three minors so far in the first period in Calgary. One PPG allowed already tonight.
